# prime-colorpicker

prime-rs: ColorPicker component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/colorpicker) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-colorpicker) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/colorpicker.md)

ColorPicker — port of `p-colorpicker` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Color selection: a swatch button opens a panel with a saturation/brightness field and a hue scale (or the panel is embedded,
`inline`). The value is a `ColorValue` in `hex`, `rgb` or `hsb` format. The color math lives in `color`.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_colorpicker::ColorPicker;

let html = view! { <ColorPicker /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-colorpicker-preview"));
// the panel is closed: it is not in the markup
assert!(!html.contains("p-colorpicker-panel"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-colorpicker = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["colorpicker"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
